reason: A DSH web plugin for processing token usage into real-time cost estimates, persistent billing records, model pricing, balance information, exports, and statistical dashboards.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 按 token 用量实时估算和统计模型费用，并提供价格管理、账本、余额、导出及可视化仪表盘。
summaries.en: A DSH Web plugin that estimates and tracks model costs from token usage with pricing management, ledger storage, balance lookup, exports, and visual dashboards.

capabilities: Tracks token usage and estimates or corrects per-turn costs
Fetches model pricing from DeepSeek pages or a custom JSON endpoint
Persists billing records locally and exports CSV or JSON
Queries DeepSeek account balance using DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
Displays cost, usage, provider, model, and budget statistics in a dashboard
